choice.basis: The dashboard legend maps pale yellow/cream to the high end (100) and dark burgundy/maroon to the low end (0). Among the three candidate states, Missouri (MO) is filled with the palest yellow/cream, indicating the highest incidence. Mississippi (MS) is dark burgundy (low), and Delaware (DE) is a darker red (mid-to-low). Therefore, MO is the highest-incidence state among the options and should be routed to the priority follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Open Missouri (MO) incidence detail for priority follow-up
